notes: Simulation and paper trading only; live execution remains disabled.
The distribution calculation is a ceiling, not an instruction to withdraw.
A 150000 JPY principal unit needs 180000 JPY equity before a 30000 JPY distribution, leaving 150000 JPY.
Six units require 1080000 JPY before a 180000 JPY distribution, leaving 900000 JPY.
Actual distribution is capped by realized monthly profit and available equity.
Fees, swaps, taxes, slippage, gaps, and stop execution risk must be accounted for.
